title: Asked for a Cheaper Incubator, the Embrace Team Made a Sleeping Bag
conflicts: Move to India: early summer 2009 to Hubli (SSIR, 2009; Open, 2009) vs 2010 (Stanford GSB, 2011); story follows the contemporary 2009 account and places only the 2011 launch in Bangalore. The slate's 'moved to Bengaluru in 2008' is unsupported (2008 was nonprofit incorporation). Price: about $25 expected in 2009 rising to about $200 at launch; the story states the rise. LBS (2017) dates the launch to 2008, against every contemporary source (April 2011); LBS used only for price.
notes: Linus Liang added to the founder field because every source names him as a co-founder. Funding 'mixed': nonprofit grants and prizes, then a for-profit arm backed by Khosla Impact and Capricorn. TED transcript did not load (JavaScript), so it is not cited.
